title: G1 Distribution: tag-triggered release workflow publishing the npm pack tarball
description: Aurora (weblings/Aurora) installs Grille from a release URL. Grille commits no dist and builds it in prepare, so a git install has no dist. Add a workflow on v* tags: npm ci, build, npm pack, upload the tarball as a release asset. Never re-upload an asset (a changed hash fails npm ci). Confirm the stray v0.2.0 tag is gone on the remote and package.json's version matches the first tag. Consumer-side bead: Aurora-daaa.7. Plan: docs/planning/WebUI/GraphEditorCleanup.md in Aurora.
acceptance_criteria: A published release whose tarball URL installs with npm ci in a scratch project with ignore-scripts; integrity hash stable across two installs.

title: G2 + G3a Popup skin and menus: Aurora surface and shadow, Popover at a point, Menu, Dialog, Button size and icon
description: Owner decisions (Aurora-daaa.5): Grille takes Aurora's popup surface and shadow and RockyRoadImport's Select picks it up; a popup shadow token that can be none keeps a WebXR no-shadow variant open (untested). Needs: Popover taking a triggerRef or a point with keyed repositioning and isNonModal; Menu and MenuItem with onAction and onKeyDown pass-through and a focus-restore callback on close; Dialog inside a Popover (holds a TextField and command items, for the editor's title menu); Button size and icon variants; tokens for menu surface, hover and popup shadow; ring fit (4px popup padding or inset ring). No React Flow knowledge in Grille; Select keeps its modal default. Consumer-side bead: Aurora-daaa.8. Depends on G1.
acceptance_criteria: Released after G1; ui.test.tsx covers point anchoring, non-modal and focus restore; Select checked in WebXR with the new shadow; Save-opens-title-menu-with-Name-focused works; command items inside a Dialog in a Popover handle arrow keys and focus.

title: G3b Add browser: Autocomplete, SearchField, sectioned ListBox, Section and Header exports
description: Needed by Aurora stage 3 (the add node browser). Autocomplete with SearchField and a sectioned ListBox, empty sections drop out while filtering. Result order follows list order, so name-first ranking stays in the editor. Plan: GraphEditorCleanup.md in Aurora. No Aurora consumer bead yet.
